scope: authored first-person spoken lines per METIS turn id — the words, not the direction

OD-B01-S01-T01.direction: the immortals gather in the bright hall of Zeus; Poseidon's seat stands empty, he feasts far off among the Ethiopians

OD-B01-S01-T02.line: How mortals love to blame the gods for their sorrows. Think of Aegisthus, who took Agamemnon's wife and cut the king down at his homecoming, though we sent Hermes himself to warn him. His own recklessness doubled the fate he was owed.
OD-B01-S01-T02.direction: seated in authority, brooding on the house of Atreus

OD-B01-S01-T03.line: Father Zeus, let Aegisthus lie in the ruin he earned. It is Odysseus my heart breaks for, wise, unlucky Odysseus, held against his will on Calypso's island, longing only for the sight of smoke rising from his own hearth. Has he not paid you sacrifice enough on the plain of Troy, Olympian?
OD-B01-S01-T03.direction: rises, bright-eyed, turning the council from old blame to a living man

OD-B01-S01-T04.line: My child, how could I forget godlike Odysseus? It is Poseidon the earth-shaker who rages without rest for the blinding of his Cyclops son, and drives that man from his homecoming. But come, let us here shape his return; one god cannot hold out against us all.
OD-B01-S01-T04.direction: leans toward Athena, granting what she came for

OD-B01-S02-T01.line: Then send Hermes, the guide, the slayer of Argus, across the water to Ogygia at once. Let him stand before the nymph Calypso with our fixed decree: hard-enduring Odysseus goes home.
OD-B01-S02-T01.direction: laying out the plan like a map before the council

OD-B01-S02-T02.line: And I go to Ithaca myself, to breathe strength into his son. I will set Telemachus on his feet, send him to call the Achaeans to assembly, and then across the sea to Pylos and Sparta for news of his father, so the boy may win a name among men.
OD-B01-S02-T02.direction: already turning toward the doors of Olympus as she speaks

OD-B01-S02-T03.line: So the gods divided the labor: release the father, waken the son. Two roads laid down at once, bending toward a single homecoming.
OD-B01-S02-T03.direction: over the dissolving council, quiet and sure

OD-B01-S02-T04.direction: binds the golden sandals under her feet, takes up the great bronze-tipped spear, and drops from the peaks of Olympus like a gust of wind

OD-B01-S03-T01.direction: stands at the outer gate of Odysseus's palace in the likeness of Mentes the Taphian captain, spear in hand, unnoticed

OD-B01-S03-T02.line: More wine here! And whose throw is it?
OD-B01-S03-T02.direction: sprawled on hides before the doors at their pebble games, shouting for meat and wine while servants hurry among them

OD-B01-S03-T03.direction: sees the stranger left standing at the gate, flushes hot with shame, and crosses the hall quickly to meet him

OD-B01-S03-T04.line: Welcome, stranger. You are kindly come to our house; give me your spear. Eat first, and afterward tell me what you need, but come, away from this noise.
OD-B01-S03-T04.direction: takes the bronze spear, clasps the stranger's hand, and leads him apart from the suitors' din

OD-B01-S04-T01.direction: seats the stranger on a carved chair spread with linen, apart from the suitors, and draws his own painted seat close for private speech

OD-B01-S04-T02.line: You see them, stranger. They devour another man's substance without payment, a man whose white bones lie rotting in the rain somewhere, or rolling in the salt surf. If he had fallen at Troy I could bear it; instead these men eat my house to nothing, and soon enough they will tear me apart as well.
OD-B01-S04-T02.direction: low-voiced, so only the guest can hear, shame and grief together

OD-B01-S04-T03.line: I am Mentes, son of wise Anchialus, lord of the oar-loving Taphians, and your father's guest-friend of old; ask grizzled Laertes if you doubt it. And hear this from me: Odysseus is not dead. He is held on a sea-girt island by rough men, and he will contrive his way home, for no man alive is richer in devices.
OD-B01-S04-T03.direction: steady-eyed in the borrowed shape, giving hope without proof

OD-B01-S04-T04.line: But tell me truly, are you Odysseus's own son? Your head, your fine eyes, you are marvelously like him as I knew him. And what is this feast, this mob filling the house? A wedding? For no man of sense could stomach such insolence under his own roof.
OD-B01-S04-T04.direction: studying the boy's face the way a friend of the father would

OD-B01-S05-T01.line: My mother neither refuses a marriage she hates nor makes an end of the matter. So from Dulichium and Same and wooded Zacynthus, and from rocky Ithaca itself, they come courting her, and day by day they grind my house to nothing.
OD-B01-S05-T01.direction: flat and exact, a boy doing accounts of his own ruin

OD-B01-S05-T02.line: Shame on them all. Oh, for Odysseus at that doorway now, helmet and shield and his two spears, the man I first knew in our house drinking and glad. A bitter, brief wooing they would find; their deaths would come down on every one of them like night.
OD-B01-S05-T02.direction: eyes flashing beyond the borrowed face, voice hard with judgment

OD-B01-S05-T03.line: Now hear me, and do it. Tomorrow call the Achaean lords to assembly and bid the suitors scatter, each man to his own home. Then fit out a ship of twenty oars and go for news of your long-gone father, to Nestor at Pylos first, then to sandy Sparta and red-haired Menelaus, the last of the bronze-clad Achaeans home.
OD-B01-S05-T03.direction: counting the steps off on her fingers, an order given as a gift

OD-B01-S05-T04.line: Have you not heard what fame Orestes won among men, striking down the schemer who murdered his famous father? You are tall and well-made, my friend; be brave, so that men born after you will speak your name. Childish things are done now; put them from you.
OD-B01-S05-T04.direction: gripping the boy's shoulder once, firmly, like a father would

OD-B01-S06-T01.line: Do not hold me longer, my road calls. Whatever gift your heart bids you give, keep it for my homeward passing, and it will be repaid with its equal.
OD-B01-S06-T01.direction: and she is gone, up and away like a sea-bird through the smoke, leaving awe and courage behind her

OD-B01-S06-T02.direction: stands taller, senses sharpened, godlike courage stirring; he walks back among the suitors with clear eyes

OD-B01-S06-T03.line: Phemius, break off this bitter song, it wastes my heart in my breast. You know many another; sing the deeds of men and gods, but not the Achaeans' coming home.
OD-B01-S06-T03.direction: descends the stair veiled, a handmaid on either side, tears on her cheeks at the song

OD-B01-S06-T04.line: Mother, let the singer sing as his mind moves him; Odysseus is not the only man who never came home from Troy. Go up to your rooms and tend your own work, the loom and the distaff; speech will be the concern of men, and mine above all, for the authority in this house is mine. And at dawn I call the assembly.
OD-B01-S06-T04.direction: quiet, controlled, the first public assertion of the master's voice

OD-B01-S06-T05.direction: bite their lips, astonished at his boldness, then shrug it off into song and dancing

OD-B01-S06-T06.line: The song died with the torches. Each man went off to his own house to sleep, and the household of Odysseus closed for the night, while Telemachus lay wrapped in a fleece, turning the voyage over in his mind.
OD-B01-S06-T06.direction: as the hall darkens, torch by torch

OD-B02-S01-T01.line: Heralds, sound the call. Summon the long-haired Achaeans to assembly at first light, every man of them.
OD-B02-S01-T01.direction: dressed and belted at dawn, sword slung at his shoulder, sandals bound

OD-B02-S01-T02.direction: strides to the meeting ground, bronze spear in hand, two swift hounds at heel, and takes his father's old seat; the elders make way for him

OD-B02-S01-T03.line: Who has called us here? Not once since great Odysseus sailed in the hollow ships have we met in council. What man had such need, young or old? Has he word of the army coming home? Whoever he is, blessings on him for it.
OD-B02-S01-T03.direction: stooped with age, first to rise, his voice carrying grief for his own lost son

OD-B02-S01-T04.line: Old sir, that man is not far to seek: I called you, and the trouble is mine. I have lost my noble father, who was king among you here and gentle as a father; and now a greater ruin besides, suitors who beset my mother against her will and devour my house day after day. By Olympian Zeus and by Themis who seats the councils of men, I call it wrong, and I cannot fight it alone.
OD-B02-S01-T04.direction: rises with the speaker's staff, composed until grief cracks through the formal charge, and he dashes the staff to the ground in tears

OD-B02-S02-T01.line: Bold-tongued Telemachus, do not lay your blame at our door. It is not the suitors who are at fault but your own mother, that queen of cunning; three years now, and nearly four, she has cheated the hearts of the Achaeans.
OD-B02-S02-T01.direction: unhurried, confident, converting predation into grievance

OD-B02-S02-T02.line: She set up her great loom in the hall, a shroud, she told us, for the lord Laertes, so no woman of the land could reproach her if he lay in death without a winding-sheet. All day she wove at that web, and every night, with torches set beside her, she unraveled it thread by thread.
OD-B02-S02-T02.direction: savoring the story, playing the assembly like a jury

OD-B02-S02-T03.line: Three years the trick held them. In the fourth, one of her own women told, and the suitors came on her by lamplight pulling the shining web apart, and she finished it because she must.
OD-B02-S02-T03.direction: over the memory of the loom, without triumph

OD-B02-S02-T04.line: Send her back to her father Icarius, and let her marry the man he names, and the man she chooses.
OD-B02-S02-T04.direction: steps close to Telemachus, palm out, an open threat wearing courtesy

OD-B02-S03-T01.line: Antinous, I will never drive from this house the mother who bore me and raised me, not while my father lives or lies dead far away. Leave my halls; feast somewhere else, eat your own stores house to house. Or stay and devour on, and I will cry to the gods who live forever that a day of reckoning come, and you die in this house unavenged.
OD-B02-S03-T01.direction: firm, measured, one hand open toward heaven

OD-B02-S03-T02.direction: sends two eagles down the mountain wind; they wheel above the assembly, tear at each other's cheeks and throats, and streak away eastward over the town

OD-B02-S03-T03.line: Men of Ithaca, hear me. Odysseus is not long from his people now; he is near, already sowing death and doom for these men. I read the birds for him the day he sailed, twenty years from home, all his companions lost, himself unknown at his return, and it is coming to pass. Let us stop the suitors now, before the ruin falls on more than them.
OD-B02-S03-T03.direction: old eyes following the birds precisely before he speaks against the crowd

OD-B02-S03-T04.line: Old man, go home and prophesy to your children. Birds are forever crossing the sunlight, and not all of them mean anything. Odysseus is dead far away, and a pity you did not die with him. Keep pouring out omens and goading this angry boy, and your prophecy will cost you a fine you will weep to pay.
OD-B02-S03-T04.direction: smooth, smiling, the threat delivered like a favor

OD-B02-S04-T01.line: Enough of this. Give me a swift ship and twenty companions, for I go to Pylos and to Sparta seeking news of my father so long away. If I hear he lives and is coming home, I can hold out one year more; if I hear he is dead, I will raise his mound, pay him all the honors owed, and give my mother to a husband.
OD-B02-S04-T01.direction: announcing the voyage plainly, though no ship or crew is yet his

OD-B02-S04-T02.line: Hear me now, men of Ithaca. Let no sceptered king ever again be kind and gentle, since none of you remembers godlike Odysseus, who ruled you mild as a father. I do not begrudge the proud suitors their violence, they wager their own heads on it. It is you I blame, the many, who sit here dumb and never say one word to shame a few.
OD-B02-S04-T02.direction: aged loyalist on his feet, moral fury shaking his staff at the crowd

OD-B02-S04-T03.line: Mentor, you crazed old rabble-baiter, would you rouse the town against us? Fighting men over a dinner is grim work. Why, if Ithacan Odysseus himself came home and found us feasting in his hall and set his heart on driving us out, his wife would have small joy of the husband she longs for; he would meet an ugly death then and there, one man against so many.
OD-B02-S04-T03.direction: brash, laughing, counting the suitors' numbers with a sweep of his eyes

OD-B02-S04-T04.line: Break it up. Go back to your fields, all of you.
OD-B02-S04-T04.direction: dissolves the assembly with a flat sweep of his arm

OD-B02-S04-T05.line: So the gathering scattered like startled birds, each man to his own house, and the suitors strolled back at their ease to the palace of godlike Odysseus.

OD-B02-S05-T01.line: Hear me, god who came yesterday to our house and bade me sail the misty sea for news of my father's return. All of it the Achaeans thwart, and the suitors first, in their evil insolence. Hear me now.
OD-B02-S05-T01.direction: alone at the grey sea's edge, hands washed in the surf, palms lifted

OD-B02-S05-T02.line: Telemachus, you will prove no coward and no fool hereafter, if one drop of your father's fine spirit is truly in you. That man made word and deed agree, and so will you; this voyage will not fail. I sailed with your father of old, and I will sail with you, and find you a swift ship besides.
OD-B02-S05-T02.direction: at his shoulder in Mentor's shape and Mentor's voice, sudden as thought

OD-B02-S05-T03.line: Go home now, and move among the suitors as if nothing has changed. Make ready the stores, wine in two-handled jars and barley meal in tight skins, the marrow of men. I will gather a willing crew through the town and choose the best ship in sea-girt Ithaca, and we launch her on the dark water tonight.
OD-B02-S05-T03.direction: brisk, operational, already scanning the harbor

OD-B02-S05-T04.line: So the voyage became a hidden thing, running quietly beneath the suitors' laughter, stores counted behind a locked door, a crew gathered by another's voice.
OD-B02-S05-T04.direction: as day tips toward evening over the town

OD-B02-S06-T01.line: Antinous, take your hand from mine. Am I to feast in quiet among you who strip my house bare? I am done with that. I will make my voyage to Pylos, as a passenger on another man's deck if I must, and I will bring ruin home to you if the gods grant it.
OD-B02-S06-T01.direction: pulls his hand free of Antinous's grip, quiet and cold before the jeering hall

OD-B02-S06-T02.direction: unlocks the high-roofed storeroom where gold and bronze lie heaped, chests of cloth, sweet oil, and jars of old wine ranged along the wall, waiting for Odysseus

OD-B02-S06-T03.line: Nurse, draw me twelve jars of wine, the finest after what you keep for that unlucky man, should Odysseus ever come. And pour twenty measures of milled barley into stitched skins. Have it gathered by nightfall, and no one is to know, least of all my mother until I am gone.
OD-B02-S06-T03.direction: low-voiced among the jars, exact as a quartermaster

OD-B02-S06-T04.line: Ah, child, why has this thought come into your heart? You are an only son, beloved, and the sea will eat you as it ate him; stay and keep what is yours. But since you will go, I swear it by the gods: your mother hears nothing from me till the twelfth day, unless she misses you and asks herself.
OD-B02-S06-T04.direction: cries out, then hushes herself, wiping tears, and takes the oath

OD-B02-S07-T01.line: Meet me at the swift ship by nightfall, friends. We sail tonight.
OD-B02-S07-T01.direction: wearing the shape and voice of Telemachus, moving man to man through the town, and asking Noemon for his fine ship, which he gladly gives

OD-B02-S07-T02.line: Telemachus, come out. Your companions sit at the oars already, waiting on your word; let us not delay the voyage.
OD-B02-S07-T02.direction: having poured sweet drowsiness over the drinking suitors, she calls softly at the hall door in Mentor's voice

OD-B02-S07-T03.direction: carry the stores down from the palace hand over hand and stow them below deck as the prince commands

OD-B02-S07-T04.direction: climbs aboard over the stern after Athena and takes his place beside the pilot's seat

OD-B02-S07-T05.direction: takes the pilot's seat herself, and sends a strong following west wind singing over the wine-dark water

OD-B02-S07-T06.line: They stepped the pine mast, sheeted home the white sail, and poured wine to the deathless gods, and above all to the grey-eyed daughter of Zeus. All night long and into the dawn the ship ran cutting her path.
OD-B02-S07-T06.direction: over the running ship, the wake bright under stars

OD-B03-S01-T01.line: At sunrise they came to Pylos, Neleus's strong-built citadel, and found the people on the shore at sacrifice, nine companies, five hundred men in each, and before each company nine black bulls for the dark-haired god who shakes the earth.
OD-B03-S01-T01.direction: as the sail drops and the shore fires come into view

OD-B03-S01-T02.line: How do I even greet such a man? I have no practice in careful speech.
OD-B03-S01-T02.direction: hangs back at the gangplank, eyes on the great king among his sons

OD-B03-S01-T03.line: Telemachus, no more shyness, not now; you crossed the sea for your father's sake. Go straight up to Nestor, breaker of horses, and ask him what counsel he keeps in his breast. Some words you will find in yourself, and a god will set the rest on your tongue, for the gods have not left you unattended from your birth.
OD-B03-S01-T03.direction: close at his ear, part push, part promise

OD-B03-S01-T04.line: Strangers, be welcome at our feast. Sit here with us on the soft fleeces and share the meal, and when you have poured to Poseidon, the cup will pass to you in turn, for it is his feast you have come upon.
OD-B03-S01-T04.direction: as Pisistratus, first to reach them, drawing them by the hand to seats on the fleeces and offering the golden cup

OD-B03-S01-T05.line: Hear me, Poseidon, girdler of the earth. Grant fame to Nestor and his sons, grace to all Pylos in return for this rich hecatomb, and grant that Telemachus and I accomplish the errand we sailed here to do.
OD-B03-S01-T05.direction: prays over the two-handled cup, pours the libation, and sets the cup in Telemachus's hands

OD-B03-S02-T01.line: Strangers, now that you have had your pleasure of the feast, it is fair to ask: who are you? From where do you sail the watery ways? Is it on business, or do you rove at hazard like raiders, who risk their own lives to bring evil upon other men?
OD-B03-S02-T01.direction: the old king turns from host to questioner, kindly but keen

OD-B03-S02-T02.line: Nestor, son of Neleus, great glory of the Achaeans, we come from Ithaca below Neion, and the errand is my own: my father, hard-enduring Odysseus, who fought at your side and sacked the city of Troy. I beg you, do not soften anything out of pity for me; tell me exactly what your own eyes saw or what word has reached you.
OD-B03-S02-T02.direction: on his feet, steadier with every word, the goddess firming his voice

OD-B03-S02-T03.line: Friend, you bring it all back, what we suffered on that plain, and the best of us fallen: Ajax lies there, and Achilles, and Patroclus wise as the gods, and my own strong Antilochus. And in every craft of war your father had no rival; no man alive could match Odysseus for cunning. Truly you are his son, your very speech is his.
OD-B03-S02-T03.direction: grief and wonder crossing the old face together as he studies the boy

OD-B03-S02-T04.line: Now, the going home. That was Athena's anger, and it began with a quarrel.
OD-B03-S02-T04.direction: settles back, eyes going distant, gathering the long memory like a man taking up a heavy rope

OD-B03-S03-T01.line: The two sons of Atreus called the army to assembly at sunset, a reckless hour, and stood and quarreled before us all. Menelaus said sail, sail now over the sea's broad back; Agamemnon would hold the host and slaughter hecatombs to appease Athena's wrath. Fool, for she was not to be turned so, and we split in two, and the night was ugly with shouting.
OD-B03-S03-T01.direction: mapping the old strategic ruin with regret and exact memory

OD-B03-S03-T02.line: At dawn, half the host dragged their ships down to the bright water, and half stayed behind with Agamemnon, lord of men.
OD-B03-S03-T02.direction: over the remembered beach, the fleet dividing

OD-B03-S03-T03.line: Turn her about. We go back to the king.
OD-B03-S03-T03.direction: in memory, swings his ships around off Tenedos and returns to Agamemnon's side

OD-B03-S03-T04.line: So we ran the open sea, and came home alive.
OD-B03-S03-T04.direction: traces the route in the air with a hand: Lesbos, the long crossing to Euboea, Geraestus by night, home

OD-B03-S03-T05.line: But of Odysseus I can tell you only what has drifted to my hearth, for I came home with no news of my own. They say the Myrmidons came safe, and Philoctetes, and Idomeneus lost not a man the war had spared; but of your father, living or dead, no traveler has brought me one certain word.
OD-B03-S03-T05.direction: honest hands open, the archive admitting its gap

OD-B03-S04-T01.line: You know how Aegisthus, while we bled at Troy, sat safe in horse-pasturing Argos and charmed Agamemnon's wife, and how he cut the king down at his own hearth on the day of his homecoming. But payment came for it: in the eighth year Orestes returned from Athens and killed his father's murderer, and all the Argives honored him for the deed.
OD-B03-S04-T01.direction: the remembered revenge held out to the boy, both warning and pattern

OD-B03-S04-T02.line: And you, my friend, tall and fine as I see you are, be brave, so that men not yet born will speak well of you. Do not wander long away from home while those proud men sit in your halls and eat everything you have.
OD-B03-S04-T02.direction: leaning close, urgency under the courtesy

OD-B03-S04-T03.line: If only the gods would give me strength like that. But they will not, not for me, not for my father.
OD-B03-S04-T03.direction: eyes down, hands closing on nothing, the wish already half surrendered

OD-B03-S04-T04.line: Telemachus, what word has escaped the barrier of your teeth? Easily, when he wills it, a god brings a man safe home from the ends of the earth. Better long roads and hard travel and a late return than to come home swiftly and die at your own hearth, as Agamemnon died.
OD-B03-S04-T04.direction: sharp as a slap, then steadying, Mentor's voice carrying more than Mentor's authority

OD-B03-S05-T01.line: The sun sank and darkness came on, and Nestor would not hear of guests sleeping on a ship's hard planks while he lived and his sons after him. To the palace, then, and to soft beds.
OD-B03-S05-T01.direction: as the shore fires burn low and the company rises

OD-B03-S05-T02.line: Go with him, Telemachus, and sleep at the king's house. But I will back to the ship, to hearten the crew, for I am the one old man among them; and at dawn I go on to the Cauconians, where a debt is owed me, no new thing and no small one.
OD-B03-S05-T02.direction: and with the last word she is gone, a sea-eagle rising off the sand; amazement seizes every man who sees it

OD-B03-S05-T03.line: Dear boy, no fear that you prove base or weak, when gods walk beside you so young, and that was no other of the Olympians but the daughter of Zeus himself, the glorious grey-eyed one who honored your father among the Argives. Be gracious, mistress: grant fair fame to me, to my children, to my honored wife, and I will sacrifice to you a yearling heifer, broad-browed, unbroken, her horns wrapped in gold.
OD-B03-S05-T03.direction: awe converting straight to prayer, arms lifted toward the vanished bird

OD-B03-S05-T04.line: At dawn they did all the king had vowed. The smith sheathed the heifer's horns in gold, the axe fell, the women raised their cry, and the goddess came glad to her sacrifice.
OD-B03-S05-T04.direction: over the ritual, the smoke climbing straight in the morning air

OD-B03-S05-T05.direction: bathed and rubbed with oil by fair Polycaste, youngest of Nestor's daughters, he steps out in a fresh cloak and tunic, formed like the immortals

OD-B03-S06-T01.line: Quickly now, my sons, harness the flowing-maned horses to the car for Telemachus, and let the housekeeper load bread and wine and such meats as kings' sons feed on. He has far to drive before nightfall.
OD-B03-S06-T01.direction: orders rolling out easy as breath, the household springing to them

OD-B03-S06-T02.direction: mounts the car beside Telemachus, gathers the reins, and cracks the team out through the echoing gate of Pylos

OD-B03-S06-T03.direction: at dusk turns the sweating team in at the door of Diocles at Phera, where they are guested for the night as custom asks

OD-B03-S06-T04.line: At first light they yoked the horses again and drove out through gate and ringing portico, all day through the wheatlands, until the sun sank and every road grew dark toward Lacedaemon.
OD-B03-S06-T04.direction: over the running car, the plain unrolling gold to the horizon

OD-B04-S01-T01.line: Softly, son of Nestor — there is a feast within, a wedding song.
OD-B04-S01-T01.direction: reins in at the palace gate amid wedding music

OD-B04-S01-T02.line: At the door a herald's voice: my lord Menelaus, two strangers stand outside, tall as the stock of Zeus. Shall we unyoke their horses and bring them in, or send them on to seek another host?
OD-B04-S01-T02.direction: as Eteoneus, glancing toward the gate

OD-B04-S01-T03.line: You talk like a fool, Eteoneus. Unyoke their horses and bring them in — how many strangers' tables fed us on our own long road home?
OD-B04-S01-T03.direction: waves the herald toward the gate, rising

OD-B04-S01-T04.line: The attendants loose the sweating horses, bathe the travelers in polished baths, rub them with oil, and seat them at the king's side where the feast is heaped and waiting.
OD-B04-S01-T04.direction: sweeps a hand across the bustle of welcome

OD-B04-S01-T05.line: Look, friend — bronze flashing through the echoing halls, gold and amber, silver and ivory. Surely the court of Zeus on Olympus is like this; wonder takes me just to look.

OD-B04-S02-T01.line: Yet for no man of them all do I grieve as for Odysseus, who labored at Troy beyond us all. His absence is sorrow to old Laertes, to steady Penelope, and to Telemachus, the child he left new-born in his hall.
OD-B04-S02-T01.direction: the young guest draws his cloak across his eyes

OD-B04-S02-T02.line: Menelaus, shall I speak what my eyes tell me? Never have I seen such likeness in man or woman — this must be Telemachus, the son Odysseus left a baby at home when for my shameless sake the Achaeans sailed to Troy.
OD-B04-S02-T02.direction: enters like Artemis, stopping short before the guest

OD-B04-S02-T03.line: You see truly, lady — this is Odysseus's son, too modest to claim it. I know such grief myself: my brother Antilochus lies at Troy, whom I was born too late to know.
OD-B04-S02-T03.direction: bows his head over the table

OD-B04-S02-T04.line: Enough — we shame the feast with weeping. Let us remember supper now; with dawn there will be time for all our tales, and tears enough to go with them.
OD-B04-S02-T04.direction: lifts his cup, steadying the room

OD-B04-S03-T01.line: Drink, friends — let the wine be kinder than the memories.
OD-B04-S03-T01.direction: slips the Egyptian drug into the mixing bowl

OD-B04-S03-T02.line: Hear one deed of that man of endurance. He scarred his own flesh with blows, threw a beggar's rags across his back, and walked through the gates of Troy — into the city of his enemies, looking like a slave.
OD-B04-S03-T02.direction: settles the hall into her tale

OD-B04-S03-T03.line: I alone knew him through the rags.
OD-B04-S03-T03.direction: mimes bathing and anointing the disguised stranger

OD-B04-S03-T04.line: Only when I had sworn a great oath not to name him did he open to me the whole design of the Achaeans.
OD-B04-S03-T04.direction: raises her hand as if still bound by that oath

OD-B04-S03-T05.direction: in memory, cuts down Trojans in the dark streets and slips back to the ships with what he learned

OD-B04-S04-T01.line: True, wife — yet you tell only half. Hear the horse's tale from within: I crouched in that timber belly with the best of the Argives, and Odysseus held command of us all, when you came circling in the dark.
OD-B04-S04-T01.direction: leans forward, answering her story with his own

OD-B04-S04-T02.line: Come out, my love — it is I.
OD-B04-S04-T02.direction: circles the great horse, calling in each wife's stolen voice

OD-B04-S04-T03.direction: stir in the cramped dark, mouths opening to answer the familiar voices

OD-B04-S04-T04.direction: clamps a hand over Anticlus's mouth and holds the men still

OD-B04-S04-T05.line: So he held them — all of them.
OD-B04-S04-T05.direction: grips the chair arm, eyes bright

OD-B04-S05-T01.line: Son of Atreus, royal Menelaus, I came for this alone: tell me plainly of my father Odysseus. Did you hear that he lives, or must I mourn him? Do not soften it out of pity — tell me what your own eyes have met.
OD-B04-S05-T01.direction: sets down his cup, meeting the king's gaze

OD-B04-S05-T02.line: The gods held me windbound off Egypt, on the isle of Pharos, till hunger gnawed my crews — until Eidothea, daughter of the sea's old man, pitied me and taught me how to seize her father Proteus and wring the truth from him.
OD-B04-S05-T02.direction: begins the long tale, eyes going distant

OD-B04-S05-T03.line: The stench of the seals nearly finished us before the struggle began.
OD-B04-S05-T03.direction: crouches as beneath a sealskin, arms locking round an invisible wrestler

OD-B04-S05-T04.line: Which of the gods taught you this trap, son of Atreus? What do you want of me?
OD-B04-S05-T04.direction: shifts through lion, serpent, leopard, boar, running water, and high-branched tree before going still

OD-B04-S05-T05.line: One more I saw, shedding great tears on an island: Odysseus, held in the halls of the nymph Calypso, with no ship and no companions to carry him over the sea's broad back.
OD-B04-S05-T05.direction: fixes his sea-gray eyes on Menelaus

OD-B04-S06-T01.line: Stay with me a month, Telemachus, and I will send you off with horses and a shining chariot — or does your heart already pull you home?
OD-B04-S06-T01.direction: lays a hand on the young man's shoulder

OD-B04-S06-T02.line: No horses, then, for rocky Ithaca — take this instead: a mixing bowl of wrought silver, its lip finished in gold, the work of Hephaestus himself.
OD-B04-S06-T02.direction: lifts the great bowl into his guest's hands

OD-B04-S06-T03.line: And this gift from me, dear child — a robe my own hands wove. Let it lie in your mother's keeping until your wedding day, and let your bride wear the memory of Helen.
OD-B04-S06-T03.direction: lays the shining robe across his arms

OD-B04-S06-T04.line: As the chariot rolls from the gate an eagle sweeps by on the right, a white goose in its talons — and Helen cries out the sign: so shall Odysseus, long away, swoop home upon the feasters in his hall and take his payment.
OD-B04-S06-T04.direction: traces the eagle's path across the sky

OD-B04-S07-T01.line: Meanwhile in Ithaca, Noemon comes asking: Antinous, when does Telemachus return from Pylos with my ship? I have need of her myself.
OD-B04-S07-T01.direction: as Noemon, approaching the lounging suitors

OD-B04-S07-T02.line: The suitors' laughter dies in their throats — the boy is truly gone, sailed clean under their noses, and the thing they mocked as impossible is fact.
OD-B04-S07-T02.direction: marks the fear moving through the hall

OD-B04-S07-T03.line: Give me a fast ship and twenty men — he shall have a black welcome home.
OD-B04-S07-T03.direction: musters his crew and sails for the strait between Ithaca and Same

OD-B04-S07-T04.line: Queen, forgive the word I carry: the suitors plot to cut Telemachus down at sea as he sails home. I heard them lay the ambush with my own ears.
OD-B04-S07-T04.direction: comes to Penelope in haste, voice low

OD-B04-S07-T05.direction: catches her as her knees give way on the threshold

OD-B04-S07-T06.line: Sleep, Penelope. Take heart: your son comes home, and a guide goes with him such as men pray to stand beside them.
OD-B04-S07-T06.direction: sends a phantom in Iphthime's shape through the bolted door to the sleeping queen

OD-B05-S01-T01.line: Dawn rises, and the gods sit again in council — Athena counting aloud the sorrows of Odysseus in the nymph's halls, and the ambush laid at sea against his son.

OD-B05-S01-T02.line: Hermes, my son, our messenger as always — go to the nymph of the braided hair and speak my fixed decree: Odysseus goes home. No god beside him, no mortal ship — on a lashed raft he shall come, through hardship, to Scheria on the twentieth day.
OD-B05-S01-T02.direction: pronounces the decree from his throne

OD-B05-S01-T03.direction: binds the golden sandals, takes up the wand, and drops seaward skimming the waves like a gull

OD-B05-S01-T04.line: Cedar smoke on the air — she is within, singing.
OD-B05-S01-T04.direction: steps into the fragrant cavern where Calypso weaves at her loom by the fire

OD-B05-S02-T01.line: Hermes of the golden wand — an honored guest, and a rare one. Sit, and let me set ambrosia and red nectar before you. What errand brings you across so much salt water? Speak it; my heart says do it, if it can be done.
OD-B05-S02-T01.direction: draws out a bright chair, setting divine food before him

OD-B05-S02-T02.line: You ask, goddess, and I answer truly: Zeus sent me — who would cross this waste of brine for pleasure? He says you keep here the most ill-fated of all the men who fought at Troy, and that it is not his doom to die far from his people. Send him quickly, and do not wake the Thunderer's anger against you.
OD-B05-S02-T02.direction: delivers the decree, courteous and immovable

OD-B05-S02-T03.line: Hard-hearted gods — jealous beyond all creatures! You cannot bear a goddess to take a mortal man openly to her bed: so Dawn was grudged Orion, so Demeter her Iasion — and now it is my turn.
OD-B05-S02-T03.direction: shudders, turning full on the messenger

OD-B05-S02-T04.line: It was I who saved him when Zeus's bolt split his ship in the wine-dark sea — but so be it, since Zeus commands. Let him go. Only I cannot send him: I have no ships, no oarsmen — my counsel he shall have, freely and unhidden, that he may come home unharmed.
OD-B05-S02-T04.direction: yields, arms folding around what she cannot keep

OD-B05-S03-T01.line: Unhappy man, weep here no longer — I am ready now to let you go. Rise; cut long timbers and build yourself a broad raft, and I will stock her with bread and water and red wine, and send a fair wind behind you for home.
OD-B05-S03-T01.direction: finds him weeping on the shore, staring at the barren sea

OD-B05-S03-T02.direction: he recoils shuddering and demands the great oath — that she plans no hidden ruin against him

OD-B05-S03-T03.line: Then witness Earth, and the wide Heaven above, and the down-dripping water of Styx — the greatest oath the blessed gods can swear: I plot no ruin against you. I counsel you only as I would counsel my own heart.
OD-B05-S03-T03.direction: raises her hand to sky, earth, and the world below

OD-B05-S03-T04.line: At supper she makes her last plea: stay, keep this house with me and never die — can Penelope, a mortal woman, outmatch a goddess in form or in beauty?
OD-B05-S03-T04.direction: gives voice to the goddess's final offer across the table

OD-B05-S03-T05.line: Goddess and queen, do not be angry — I know it all: wise Penelope must fade beside you, for she is mortal and you are deathless. Even so, every day I long for home and the hour of my return. And if some god wrecks me again on the wine-dark water, I will endure that too — my heart is old in suffering.
OD-B05-S03-T05.direction: answers gently, eyes on the sea

OD-B05-S04-T01.line: Here at the island's edge the tall trees stand — alder and poplar and sky-high fir, long dry, that will ride light on the water. Take the great bronze axe and the adze; here is cloth for a sail and cord to lace her. Build, and I will bring all the rest.
OD-B05-S04-T01.direction: leads him to the grove, laying the tools in his hands

OD-B05-S04-T02.direction: watches four days as he fells, trims, bores, joins, decks, and fences the timbers

OD-B05-S04-T03.direction: he steps the mast, hangs yard and sail, fits the steering oar and stone ballast

OD-B05-S04-T04.line: Go then — and remember, sometimes, the one who let you go.
OD-B05-S04-T04.direction: bathes and clothes him, loads food and water aboard, and sends a warm following wind

OD-B05-S05-T01.line: Seventeen days he steers and never sleeps, the Pleiades and late-setting Bootes on his watch, the Bear on his left hand as the goddess taught — until on the eighteenth the shadowed mountains of Scheria rise like a shield laid on the misty sea.
OD-B05-S05-T01.direction: charts the long watch beneath turning stars

OD-B05-S05-T02.line: So — the gods changed their minds about Odysseus while I feasted far away. Yet even now I will give him his fill of trouble.
OD-B05-S05-T02.direction: gathers cloud, churns the deep with his trident, and looses all four winds together

OD-B05-S05-T03.line: A toppling sea takes the raft broadside — she spins, the mast cracks, and the whole frame rolls.
OD-B05-S05-T03.direction: the storm swallows the small craft

OD-B05-S05-T04.direction: hurled under, spits brine, claws his way back onto the wallowing timbers

OD-B05-S05-T05.line: Then Ino of the slim ankles rises on the wave like a shearwater: poor man, why does Poseidon hate you so? Strip off those clothes, leave the raft to the winds, and swim for the Phaeacian shore — bind this immortal veil beneath your chest, and when you touch land cast it back to the sea, and turn your face away.
OD-B05-S05-T05.direction: as Ino, holding out the veil across the water

OD-B05-S05-T06.direction: stills the gale and sets the north wind flattening the seas before him toward shore

OD-B05-S06-T01.direction: swims two nights and two days, spent, toward the roar of reef and breaking surf

OD-B05-S06-T02.line: There — where the river meets the sea.
OD-B05-S06-T02.direction: turns his eye to a smooth river mouth, clear of rocks and sheltered from the wind

OD-B05-S06-T03.line: Hear me, lord of this stream, whoever you are — I come to your current a suppliant, fleeing Poseidon's anger out of the sea. Even the deathless gods respect a wandering man who comes in need; pity me, lord, for I claim that mercy now.
OD-B05-S06-T03.direction: the river stills its current and gathers him in

OD-B05-S06-T04.line: Your veil, goddess — with my life for thanks.
OD-B05-S06-T04.direction: casts the veil seaward with face averted, crawls ashore, and creeps beneath two intertwined olive bushes

OD-B05-S06-T05.direction: heaps dry leaves over his body; Athena pours sleep upon his eyes

OD-B06-S01-T01.direction: glides to the palace of Alcinous and enters the girl's chamber in the likeness of her dearest friend

OD-B06-S01-T02.line: Nausicaa, how did your mother bear so careless a daughter? Your bright clothes lie unwashed, and your wedding day is near, when you must be finely dressed and dress those who attend you. Come — ask your father for the wagon at dawn, for the washing pools lie far from town.
OD-B06-S01-T02.direction: bends over the sleeping girl in a friend's shape

OD-B06-S01-T03.line: Papa dear, will you not have the high wagon yoked for me, so I can take our fine clothes to the river and wash them? You yourself need clean linen for the council, and five sons in this house are forever wanting fresh things for the dancing.
OD-B06-S01-T03.direction: stands close to her father, keeping her true thought behind her eyes

OD-B06-S01-T04.line: Neither mules nor anything else do I grudge you, child. Go — the servants will yoke the high wagon, the one with the box for the wash.
OD-B06-S01-T04.direction: smiles, seeing more than he says

OD-B06-S01-T05.line: Her mother packs a hamper with food of every kind, wine in a goatskin, and soft olive oil in a golden flask, for the girls to anoint themselves after bathing.
OD-B06-S01-T05.direction: notes the quiet provisioning at the palace door

OD-B06-S02-T01.line: Into the channels, girls — tread it clean, and race me while you do.
OD-B06-S02-T01.direction: drives to the washing pools, unharnesses the mules to graze, and treads the clothes in the channels

OD-B06-S02-T02.direction: spreads the garments on clean shingle, bathes, eats, and leads the singing ball game

OD-B06-S02-T03.direction: tips the thrown ball wide, into the deep eddying water

OD-B06-S02-T04.line: The ball drops into deep water, and the girls' cry goes up long and bright along the shore.
OD-B06-S02-T04.direction: lets the cry hang in the air

OD-B06-S02-T05.line: Girls' voices — what country of men have I come to now?
OD-B06-S02-T05.direction: starts awake beneath the leaves, listening

OD-B06-S03-T01.line: Not the knees — words, and from a distance.
OD-B06-S03-T01.direction: weighs clasping her knees against speech, and chooses distance

OD-B06-S03-T02.line: Breaking a leafy branch to shield his body, he steps out salt-crusted and terrible, like a mountain lion driven by hunger down among the flocks.
OD-B06-S03-T02.direction: shadows his emergence from the thicket

OD-B06-S03-T03.line: The maids scatter down the spits of sand — but Nausicaa alone stands fast, for Athena plants courage in her heart and stills the trembling in her limbs.
OD-B06-S03-T03.direction: holds the girl steady in the frame

OD-B06-S03-T04.line: At your knees, lady — though I dare not touch them — tell me: are you goddess or mortal? Never have my eyes seen your like, and I have suffered: long days the sea broke over me, and I know not one soul in this land. Pity a stranger — grant me some cast rag to wear, and show me the way to your town.
OD-B06-S03-T04.direction: keeps his distance, palms open, voice low and crafted

OD-B06-S03-T05.line: Stranger, you seem neither base nor witless, and Zeus deals fortune as he wills — what he gives, a man must bear. But you have come to our land now, and you shall lack neither clothing nor anything owed a hard-tried suppliant. Stand, girls — this man is no enemy; wash him where the river gives shelter, and set food and oil beside him.
OD-B06-S03-T05.direction: steadies her voice and calls back her scattered maids

OD-B06-S04-T01.line: The maids set food, the golden flask of oil, and clothing beside the eddying river, and withdraw while he washes the crusted brine from his back and shoulders.
OD-B06-S04-T01.direction: turns the scene away to give the washing privacy

OD-B06-S04-T02.direction: sheds grace upon his head and shoulders — taller now, broader, his hair clustering like hyacinth

OD-B06-S04-T03.line: Listen, girls — the gods themselves have a hand on this man. Before, he seemed rough and poor to me; now he is like the gods who hold wide heaven.
OD-B06-S04-T03.direction: watches him from along the shore, low-voiced to her maids

OD-B06-S04-T04.line: Let him eat in peace — fold the wash and load the wagon.
OD-B06-S04-T04.direction: oversees the folding and loading while the stranger eats like a starving man

OD-B06-S04-T05.line: Rise now, stranger, and follow while we cross the fields — but when we near the town, wait in Athena's grove of poplars until you judge we have reached my father's house, so no sailor's idle tongue can shame me. Then come into the city and ask for the palace of great-hearted Alcinous; walk straight through the hall and clasp the knees of my mother Arete first. Win her heart, and you may hope to look on your home and your own people again.
OD-B06-S04-T05.direction: gives her instructions clearly, eyes forward on the road

OD-B07-S01-T01.line: Go softly, stranger, and wait among my father's poplars until I am within.
OD-B07-S01-T01.direction: leaves him at the grove and walks on to the palace

OD-B07-S01-T02.direction: Odysseus enters the city wrapped in a fold of divine mist

OD-B07-S01-T03.line: You look lost, stranger. Come, I will bring you to the house you seek, for it lies near my own father's.
OD-B07-S01-T03.direction: appears as a young girl carrying a pitcher, leading him through streets and harbor

OD-B07-S01-T04.line: These Phaeacians love oar and sail and do not warm to strangers, so walk quickly and question no one. Go straight through the hall to the queen, Arete, whom the people honor like a god. Win her heart, and you may yet see your home and your own high-roofed house.

OD-B07-S02-T01.line: Walls of bronze, and doors of gold on silver posts — a light lies on this house like the sun and moon together.
OD-B07-S02-T01.direction: halts before the palace, marveling at the guardian dogs of gold and silver

OD-B07-S02-T02.line: Fifty women within, some grinding the yellow grain, some at the looms — their hands flicker like poplar leaves in wind.

OD-B07-S02-T03.line: And outside the courtyard the great orchard bears through every season: pear ripens upon pear, fig upon fig, grape upon grape, and the west wind never lets the garden sleep.
OD-B07-S02-T03.direction: sweeps the scene wide before returning to the man in the mist

OD-B07-S02-T04.direction: crosses the threshold hidden in mist and finds the lords at their feast

OD-B07-S03-T01.direction: the mist falls away the moment his arms reach Arete

OD-B07-S03-T02.line: Arete, daughter of Rhexenor, after many trials I come to your knees, and to your king, and to all these feasters — may the gods give you long joy. For me, ask only this: grant me convoy to my own country, for I have suffered long, far from everyone I love.
OD-B07-S03-T02.direction: clasps the queen's knees, then sits down in the ashes by the hearth

OD-B07-S03-T03.line: Alcinous, this is not well, and it does not befit you: a stranger sitting in the ashes of your hearth. Raise him up, seat him on a silver-studded chair, and let the herald mix wine, for Zeus himself walks with suppliants.
OD-B07-S03-T03.direction: the old counselor breaks the hall's silence

OD-B07-S03-T04.line: You honor me beyond my hope, great king. May the gods repay this house.
OD-B07-S03-T04.direction: rises from the ashes to the seat beside the king and eats

OD-B07-S04-T01.line: The hall empties; only the king and queen remain. And Arete's eye comes to rest on his cloak and tunic — cloth her own hands wove with her women.
OD-B07-S04-T01.direction: narrows the scene to the queen's studying gaze

OD-B07-S04-T02.line: Stranger, I will ask you first myself: who are you, and from what people? And who gave you those clothes — did you not say you came to us wandering over the sea?
OD-B07-S04-T02.direction: the queen's question, quiet and exact

OD-B07-S04-T03.line: Hard to tell all my griefs, queen, for the gods have given me many. Far off lies an island where the goddess Calypso held me seven years against my will, and when at last I sailed, the sea broke my raft and threw me naked on your shore. It was your daughter who found me, fed me, and gave me these clothes — blame her for nothing, for I chose to walk behind alone, fearing men's idle talk.
OD-B07-S04-T03.direction: gives truth enough, shielding the princess, keeping his name

OD-B07-S04-T04.line: One thing only my daughter missed, that she did not bring you straight to our doors — yet your care does you credit, stranger. Would to Zeus a man like you might stay, and be called my son, with house and wealth from my hand. But no one holds you against your will: tomorrow you shall have ship and oarsmen for your home, though it lie farther than the farthest island.
OD-B07-S04-T04.direction: admiration widening into an open-handed offer

OD-B08-S01-T01.line: To assembly, captains and counselors of the Phaeacians! Come and learn of the stranger newly come to the wise king's house — a man like the deathless gods to look on!
OD-B08-S01-T01.direction: moves through the dawn city in a herald's shape

OD-B08-S01-T02.direction: sheds grace on Odysseus, making him taller and mightier to every eye

OD-B08-S01-T03.line: Draw a black ship down to the bright sea, and let fifty-two picked youths make her ready for the voyage. The rest of you, lords, come to my hall — we feast this stranger. And summon Demodocus, for to him the god has given song beyond all others.
OD-B08-S01-T03.direction: orders sailing and feast in one breath

OD-B08-S01-T04.line: So the ship is moored out in deep water, and the palace fills — porches and courts and halls — with young men and old, and the smell of roasting rises.

OD-B08-S02-T01.line: Sing, Demodocus! Sing the famous quarrel — Odysseus and Achilles, best of the Achaeans, at strife with high words at the gods' rich feast!
OD-B08-S02-T01.direction: the listeners call as the herald sets the lyre in the blind singer's hands

OD-B08-S02-T02.direction: draws the great purple cloak over his head and weeps unseen, uncovering between verses

OD-B08-S02-T03.line: Rest the lyre — we have had our fill of feast and song. Out to the games now, all of you, that our guest may tell his people at home how far we surpass all men at boxing, wrestling, the jump, and the race!
OD-B08-S02-T03.direction: alone marks the guest's hidden tears and rises

OD-B08-S02-T04.line: So the whole company pours out from the hall at the king's heels, toward the marked field of contest.
OD-B08-S02-T04.direction: carries the scene from feast to field

OD-B08-S03-T01.line: The youths of Phaeacia rise up: they run and the dust hangs over the plain, they wrestle, they leap, they hurl the discus, they trade blows in boxing.
OD-B08-S03-T01.direction: names each contest as it flashes past

OD-B08-S03-T02.line: Come, father stranger, try our games yourself — you have the build of an athlete under those griefs. No fame in a man's life is greater than what his own hands and feet win him.
OD-B08-S03-T02.direction: steps forward courteously with the invitation

OD-B08-S03-T03.line: No, I see no athlete here. A master of cargoes, rather — one who minds his freight and his greedy profits. Nothing of the games in him.

OD-B08-S03-T04.line: That was badly spoken, young man, and it stings me to my feet. See where the stone flew — past every mark of yours, and I threw it clothed and weary. Now let any Phaeacian but Laodamas, my host's son, come and try me — boxing, wrestling, or the race, I refuse no one.
OD-B08-S03-T04.direction: seizes the greatest discus and hurls it whistling beyond all the marks

OD-B08-S03-T05.line: Peace, stranger — no man of sense could fault your worth. Watch now what we do best, for in swift ships and the running foot, in dance and song, we lead all men.
OD-B08-S03-T05.direction: calms the field and signals for dancers and lyre

OD-B08-S04-T01.line: Hear now how Ares and golden Aphrodite lay together in secret, and how the lame smith Hephaestus forged a net fine as spider-thread that no eye could see, and caught the lovers fast in his own bed till all the gods stood laughing at the door.
OD-B08-S04-T01.direction: sings to the lyre while the circle dances

OD-B08-S04-T02.direction: leap and spin in the ring, the crimson ball flashing hand to hand

OD-B08-S04-T03.line: Alcinous, you boasted your dancers were the best beneath the sun, and here the boast stands proved. Wonder takes me as I watch — their feet flash and my eyes cannot follow.

OD-B08-S04-T04.line: Then the twelve lords bring gifts for the guest — fresh-washed cloak and tunic and a talent of precious gold from each — and the heralds carry all before the queen.
OD-B08-S04-T04.direction: measures out the wealth of the giving

OD-B08-S04-T05.line: Farewell, father stranger — if a harsh word was spoken, let the storm winds snatch it up and carry it away. Take this sword of bronze, silver on the hilt, the sheath new-carved ivory, and may the gods grant you your home and your wife.
OD-B08-S04-T05.direction: lays the sword in Odysseus's hands, pride bent into apology

OD-B08-S05-T01.line: Demodocus, above all mortals I honor you — the Muse taught you, surely, or Apollo, for you sing the Achaeans' fate as though you stood among them. Take this cut of honor from my own portion. Now shift your ground and sing the wooden horse, the trap Epeius built with Athena, that noble Odysseus led up into Troy filled with fighting men.
OD-B08-S05-T01.direction: sends the choice meat to the bard, asking for his own hidden story

OD-B08-S05-T02.line: And the bard sings: the Argives spilling from the horse's hollow flank, the city burning, and Odysseus with Menelaus at the doors of Deiphobus, fighting his grimmest fight until Athena gave him victory.
OD-B08-S05-T02.direction: the song rises while one listener begins to break

OD-B08-S05-T03.direction: melts into weeping beneath his cloak, as a woman weeps fallen on her husband's body

OD-B08-S05-T04.line: Stop the lyre, Demodocus — not all here take joy of it, for since the song began our guest has not once left off weeping. Now, stranger, hide it no longer: tell me the name your father and mother called you, and your land and your city. And say why you weep at the doom of the Argives and Troy — did some kinsman fall there, or a comrade dear as a brother?
OD-B08-S05-T04.direction: turns observation into the direct question at last

OD-B08-S05-T05.line: You ask, king, and I will tell you all of it — though the telling opens every wound.
OD-B08-S05-T05.direction: settles upright, gathering breath for the long tale

OD-B09-S01-T01.line: Alcinous, mighty king, it is a fine thing to hear a singer such as this, whose voice is like a god's. No moment is sweeter than when joy holds a whole people — feasters ranged down the hall listening, the tables full of bread and meat, the steward pouring wine. This seems to my own heart the fairest thing there is.
OD-B09-S01-T01.direction: praise laid down like a threshold before the leap

OD-B09-S01-T02.line: But you ask my name, and I will hide it no longer. I am Odysseus, son of Laertes, known to all men for my cunning, and my fame goes up to heaven.
OD-B09-S01-T02.direction: the name dropped into the silent hall

OD-B09-S01-T03.line: My home is Ithaca, clear under the sun — rough ground, no place for horses, but a good nurse of men. I have looked on Calypso's island and on wonders past counting, and seen nothing sweeter than a man's own country.
OD-B09-S01-T03.direction: opens his hands to the hall, homesick in the telling

OD-B09-S01-T04.line: Come then — I will tell you the bitter homecoming Zeus gave me out of Troy.
OD-B09-S01-T04.direction: begins the tale, and the hall leans in

OD-B09-S02-T01.line: Ismarus is ours! Share out the spoil and the women — equal portions, no man cheated!
OD-B09-S02-T01.direction: sack the Cicones' city and heap the plunder on the sand

OD-B09-S02-T02.line: Not yet, captain! The sheep are fat and the wine runs dark and sweet — one more cup on the beach, and then we row!
OD-B09-S02-T02.direction: the crews wave off the order and feast on

OD-B09-S02-T03.line: For Ismarus! Drive the sea-thieves into the water!
OD-B09-S02-T03.direction: come on in ranks at dawn, thick as leaves in spring, with chariots

OD-B09-S02-T04.line: Six benches from every ship stand empty when at dusk the fleet claws free — glad to be alive, and grieving for the comrades left behind.
OD-B09-S02-T04.direction: counts the cost as the shore recedes

OD-B09-S03-T01.line: Nine days the north wind and the killing seas drive the ships off course, past Cythera, off the edge of the known world.

OD-B09-S03-T02.line: On the tenth day they land where the Lotus-eaters dwell, and three men go inland to learn what people eat bread in that country.
OD-B09-S03-T02.direction: sets the scouts walking into the green quiet

OD-B09-S03-T03.line: The Lotus-eaters plan no death for them. They offer only the lotus, honey-sweet.
OD-B09-S03-T03.direction: the gentlest danger in the whole tale

OD-B09-S03-T04.line: But whoever eats that fruit forgets the way home, and wishes only to stay among the lotus-eating people, grazing on flowers, all memory of return dissolved.
OD-B09-S03-T04.direction: lets the forgetting settle over the scene

OD-B09-S03-T05.line: Take them, though they weep — bind them under the benches! The rest of you aboard and to your oars now, before another man tastes the lotus and forgets his home.
OD-B09-S03-T05.direction: drags the weeping scouts to the ships by force

OD-B09-S04-T01.line: The fleet comes then to a wooded island where wild goats breed and no plow has ever cut, lying just across the water from the land of the Cyclopes.
OD-B09-S04-T01.direction: raises the new shore out of the dark

OD-B09-S04-T02.line: Some god pilots them through the night, for no ship can be seen — they glide into a harbor that needs no anchor stone, and sleep on the sand till dawn.

OD-B09-S04-T03.line: At dawn they hunt the goats down the glens and feast until sundown — and across the strait they see the smoke of the Cyclopes' fires, and hear voices, and the bleating of sheep.
OD-B09-S04-T03.direction: turns every head toward the far shore

OD-B09-S04-T04.line: The rest of you stay by the ships. My own crew comes with me — I will cross and learn what men live yonder: savages without law, or god-fearing folk who welcome strangers.
OD-B09-S04-T04.direction: boards his own ship with chosen men

OD-B09-S05-T01.line: The wine of Maron comes with us — twelve men, follow me. My heart says we go to meet a man of great strength, lawless and wild.
OD-B09-S05-T01.direction: slings the wineskin and leads twelve up to the huge cave

OD-B09-S05-T02.line: Look — racks bending under cheeses, pens of lambs and kids, each age folded apart, and the pails swimming with whey. A careful hand keeps this place.
OD-B09-S05-T02.direction: surveys the cave stores in the half-dark

OD-B09-S05-T03.line: Let us take the cheeses and drive the lambs and kids to the ship, they begged him — take them and run for the salt water while we can.
OD-B09-S05-T03.direction: voices the crew's desperate good sense

OD-B09-S05-T04.line: No — we wait. I would see the master of this cave myself, and take the guest-gift that strangers are owed. My men saw truer than I, and how much better it would have been to listen.
OD-B09-S05-T04.direction: the teller judging his own past folly

OD-B09-S06-T01.line: Hup! In, you woolly bellies — in!
OD-B09-S06-T01.direction: hurls down a mountain of firewood and drives the flock inside

OD-B09-S06-T02.direction: heaves across the entrance a slab twenty-two wagons could not move

OD-B09-S06-T03.direction: milks ewes and goats in order, sets each young to its mother, curdles half the milk, kindles the fire

OD-B09-S06-T04.line: The firelight finds them, huddled in the deep of the cave — and the great voice falls on them like the slab itself: Strangers! Who are you, and from where do you sail the wet ways — traders, or pirates roving with your lives in your hands?
OD-B09-S06-T04.direction: the demand shakes dust from the cave walls

OD-B09-S07-T01.line: We are Achaeans out of Troy, men of Agamemnon, whose fame is the widest now under heaven — driven here by every wind on the wrong sea-roads. We come to your knees, hoping the welcome due a guest. Respect the gods, mighty one: Zeus himself walks with strangers and avenges them.

OD-B09-S07-T02.line: You are a fool, stranger, or come from very far, to bid me fear your gods. We Cyclopes care nothing for Zeus of the aegis — we are stronger by far, and I spare no man for fear of heaven. But tell me: where did you moor that fine ship of yours — far up the coast, or near?
OD-B09-S07-T02.direction: contempt draped over a probing trap

OD-B09-S07-T03.line: Ship? Poseidon smashed her on the rocks at the headland of your land. These men and I alone climbed out of the sea.
OD-B09-S07-T03.direction: answers smoothly, giving the ship nothing

OD-B09-S07-T04.line: No answer — he springs, and his hands close on two of the men and dash them on the stone like puppies, and he tears them limb from limb for his supper, leaving nothing.
OD-B09-S07-T04.direction: the horror told flat and fast

OD-B09-S07-T05.line: We lifted our hands to Zeus, weeping — there was nothing else our hands could do.
OD-B09-S07-T05.direction: prays with the survivors while the giant drinks milk and sleeps among his flocks

OD-B09-S08-T01.line: No — strike now and we die here with him. No arm of ours could ever roll that stone from the door.
OD-B09-S08-T01.direction: stays his own sword hand at the sleeping throat

OD-B09-S08-T02.direction: snatches two more men for his morning meal, whistles the flock out, seals the stone behind him

OD-B09-S08-T03.line: The olive trunk there — his own club. Cut it to a fathom, smooth it, harden the point in the fire. He has given us our weapon himself.
OD-B09-S08-T03.direction: shapes the stake and chars its tip, then hides it

OD-B09-S08-T04.line: They bury the stake beneath the deep dung and cast lots for four to stand with him at the eye — and the lots fall on the very men he would have chosen.

OD-B09-S08-T05.line: Here, Cyclops — drink wine on that man-flesh you have eaten, and learn what drink our ship carried. You ask my name, and I will tell it for the guest-gift you promised: Nobody is my name. Nobody — so my father and mother and all my friends call me.
OD-B09-S08-T05.direction: holds up the ivy bowl of unmixed wine

OD-B09-S09-T01.line: Give me more, freely — and here is your gift, Nobody, to warm your heart: I eat Nobody last, after all his friends. There is my guest-gift to you.
OD-B09-S09-T01.direction: drains the third bowl and topples backward into drunken sleep

OD-B09-S09-T02.line: Now — for our dead. Drive it!
OD-B09-S09-T02.direction: pulls the glowing stake from the coals and drives it into the eye with his four men

OD-B09-S09-T03.direction: leans his weight and twists the stake like a shipwright's drill as blood and steam boil out

OD-B09-S09-T04.direction: tears the stake free and roars until the rock rings

OD-B09-S09-T05.line: What ails you, Polyphemus, that you wake the deathless night with screaming — is some man stealing your flocks, or killing you by craft or force? If Nobody harms you, alone as you are, it is sickness sent by Zeus, and cannot be helped — pray to your father Poseidon.
OD-B09-S09-T05.direction: voices gather at the sealed stone, then shuffle away into the dark

OD-B09-S09-T06.line: Where are you, worm? You will not walk living out of my door.
OD-B09-S09-T06.direction: rolls back the stone and sits groping with spread hands across the entrance

OD-B09-S10-T01.line: Softly, softly — every back passes under my hands.
OD-B09-S10-T01.direction: sits blind in the doorway at dawn, feeling each fleece as it passes

OD-B09-S10-T02.direction: lashes rams three abreast with willow withes, slinging a man beneath each middle beast

OD-B09-S10-T03.line: I took the great lead ram myself and hung beneath his belly, my hands twisted in that miracle of wool, and dared not breathe. Over my head the blind master mourned to him: Sweet ram, why last from the cave today, you who were always first — do you grieve for your master's eye?
OD-B09-S10-T03.direction: the teller reliving the longest moments of the escape

OD-B09-S10-T04.line: Clear of the cave and the yard, he frees himself first and unties his men — and they drive the fat, long-legged flock down to the ship, looking back often, and bend to the oars.
OD-B09-S10-T04.direction: the escape breaking into open speed

OD-B09-S10-T05.line: Share out the flock, every man his portion — and the great ram goes to Zeus, lord of the dark cloud, with the thighs burnt on the fire.
OD-B09-S10-T05.direction: sacrifices the ram on the shore of the island

OD-B09-S11-T01.line: Cyclops! It was no weak man's friends you ate in your hollow cave — your evil deeds were bound to find you out! You dared devour guests in your own house, and Zeus and the gods have paid you for it!
OD-B09-S11-T01.direction: shouts across the water despite his men's frantic pleading

OD-B09-S11-T02.direction: rips the crest from a mountain and hurls it at the sound, the wave driving the ship back toward shore

OD-B09-S11-T03.line: Cyclops — if any mortal ever asks who put out your eye so shamefully, tell him this: it was Odysseus, sacker of cities, who blinded you — Laertes's son, whose home is in Ithaca!
OD-B09-S11-T03.direction: stands and gives the fatal name across the widening water

OD-B09-S11-T04.line: So the old prophecy comes home — Telemus foretold I would lose my sight at the hands of Odysseus, and I watched all these years for a great man, not this little worthless nothing who undid me with wine. Hear me, Poseidon, dark-haired shaker of the earth, if I am truly your son: grant that Odysseus, sacker of cities, never reach his home. Or if he must, let him come late and broken, on a stranger's ship, all his comrades lost — and find trouble waiting in his house.
OD-B09-S11-T04.direction: spreads his hands to the starry sky, praying to his father

OD-B09-S11-T05.line: He heaves a second stone, greater still — it falls a blade's width short astern, and the wave carries the ship on to the island where the fleet waits, weeping for the lost.

OD-B10-S01-T01.line: A month you have sat at my table, man of Troy, and still I hunger for the tale. Tell it again — the horse, the ships, the burning.
OD-B10-S01-T01.direction: hosts and listens, cup in hand

OD-B10-S01-T02.line: Take this bag of oxhide, Odysseus — every rough wind is bound inside, sewn shut with silver wire. I loose the West Wind only; let it carry you home to Ithaca.

OD-B10-S01-T03.line: Nine days and nights he held the sheet unsleeping, till the watch-fires of Ithaca winked on the shore. Then sleep took him at the helm.
OD-B10-S01-T03.direction: marks the turning of the voyage

OD-B10-S01-T04.line: His men eyed the bag and muttered of gold and silver. They cut the silver wire — and the winds burst shrieking out, and hurled them wailing back to Aeolia.

OD-B10-S01-T05.line: Out of my island — out, worst of living men! You come back cursed; the blessed gods themselves hate you. I give no help to what heaven hunts.

OD-B10-S02-T01.line: They came to the Laestrygonian land, where a narrow harbor lies ringed by sheer cliffs, and the fleet slid in as into a closed hand.
OD-B10-S02-T01.direction: sets the trap of the harbor

OD-B10-S02-T02.line: Not I. I make fast to the rock outside.
OD-B10-S02-T02.direction: moors alone beyond the cliff mouth

OD-B10-S02-T03.line: Three men went inland to learn who ate bread in that country. At the spring a girl tall as a tower met them, and pointed the way to her father's house.

OD-B10-S02-T04.line: Gods — the king snatched up my man and made his supper of him.

OD-B10-S02-T05.line: Then the Laestrygonians came in thousands, giants and not men. From the cliffs they speared the crews like fish, and rained down boulders till the trapped ships splintered.

OD-B10-S02-T06.line: Cut the cable! Bend to the oars, all of you, or we die with them!

OD-B10-S03-T01.line: One ship alone reached Aeaea, Circe's island. Two days and two nights they lay on the shore, eating their hearts with grief and weariness.

OD-B10-S03-T02.line: Smoke rises inland — some hearth burns beyond the oaks. But first, meat: this stag will feed us all tonight.

OD-B10-S03-T03.line: Two companies, friends. Eurylochus leads one and I the other — now shake the lots in the helmet.

OD-B10-S03-T04.line: The lot falls to me. Come then, you twenty-two — and gods keep the rest of you by the ship.

OD-B10-S04-T01.line: Weave and shine, weave and shine — so runs the thread, so runs the world.
OD-B10-S04-T01.direction: sings at the loom, beasts fawning

OD-B10-S04-T02.line: Go in if you must. I smell a snare in all this sweetness — I stay outside.
OD-B10-S04-T02.direction: hangs back at the shining doors

OD-B10-S04-T03.line: Drink deep, strangers — cheese and barley, pale honey, Pramnian wine. Now the wand: go to the sty where you belong.
OD-B10-S04-T03.direction: serves the cup, strikes each man

OD-B10-S04-T04.line: They took on the bristles and snouts and bodies of swine — but their minds stayed human, and they wept, remembering.

OD-B10-S04-T05.line: In with you. Acorns and cornel-berries — the proper food of what you are now.

OD-B10-S04-T06.line: They are gone, Odysseus — all of them! They went in at the shining doors and not one came out. I waited long, and called, and no man answered.

OD-B10-S05-T01.line: Bind on my sword and say no more, Eurylochus. Necessity drives — I go alone.
OD-B10-S05-T01.direction: slings sword and bow, strides inland

OD-B10-S05-T02.line: Where now, unlucky man, alone through these hills and knowing nothing of the ground? Your friends are penned as pigs in Circe's sties — and you march straight in to join them.

OD-B10-S05-T03.line: Here — take this herb of power and carry it against her drugs. The gods call it moly: black at the root, its flower white as milk. Hard for mortal men to dig, but the gods can do all things.
OD-B10-S05-T03.direction: pulls the herb from the earth

OD-B10-S05-T04.line: When she strikes you with her wand, draw your sword and rush her as if to kill. And before you go to her bed, make her swear the great oath of the gods that she plots no further harm — lest she strip you naked and unman you.
OD-B10-S05-T04.direction: lays out each step, then vanishes

OD-B10-S06-T01.line: Drink it all, stranger. Now — to the sty, and lie down with your friends!

OD-B10-S06-T02.line: But the herb held. The drug rolled off him like water off oiled wood, and he stood before her unchanged.
OD-B10-S06-T02.direction: the moly does its silent work

OD-B10-S06-T03.direction: shrinks back as he rushes sword-first

OD-B10-S06-T04.line: You are Odysseus — the man of many turns that Hermes always said would come from Troy. Sheathe your sword; come to my bed instead, that we may learn to trust each other.

OD-B10-S06-T05.line: First swear the great oath, goddess: no new harm against me, nothing planned while I lie unarmed in your house.

OD-B10-S06-T06.line: She swore, and her women bathed and dressed him and set the feast — but he sat with untouched hands. What honest man eats while his friends stand penned as swine?

OD-B10-S07-T01.line: Come, I will show you. This salve undoes what the other wrought.

OD-B10-S07-T02.line: The bristles fell away, and they stood up men again — younger than before, taller, and fairer to look upon.

OD-B10-S07-T03.direction: opens the pens, stands aside from the weeping reunion

OD-B10-S07-T04.line: Even my heart, which does not melt, is moved. Go down, beach your ship and bring the rest of your men — my halls will hold you all.

OD-B10-S07-T05.line: Haul the ship high and follow me — your shipmates sit feasting alive in Circe's hall. Eurylochus cries snare and ruin; I say the danger is past, and hanging back now costs more than you fear.

OD-B10-S07-T06.line: Sit, eat your meat and drink your wine, day upon day, till the heart comes back into your chests.
OD-B10-S07-T06.direction: presides over the long year of feasting

OD-B10-S08-T01.line: Circe, keep now the promise that you made me: send me home. My own heart strains for Ithaca, and my men's hearts with mine — will you loose us at last?

OD-B10-S08-T02.line: To the house of Death? Before Ithaca I must sail down to Hades and question blind Tiresias of Thebes? Then that is the road, though it breaks every heart aboard.

OD-B10-S08-T03.line: Set your mast and sit still — the North Wind will carry you across Ocean to Persephone's grove of poplar and willow. There dig a trench a cubit square, and pour to all the dead honey and milk, sweet wine, water, and white barley. Bleed a ram and a black ewe into it — the dead will come, but hold them from the blood until Tiresias has drunk.
OD-B10-S08-T03.direction: maps the road to the dead

OD-B10-S08-T04.direction: wakes on the roof, missteps, falls, neck breaks

OD-B10-S08-T05.line: They put out grieving for a road no living ship should sail — and behind the dark prow Circe sent a fair following wind, a good companion.

OD-B11-S01-T01.line: The ship came to deep-flowing Ocean's edge, to the land of the Cimmerians, wrapped in mist and cloud, where the shining sun never looks down.

OD-B11-S01-T02.line: By milk and honey, wine and white barley, I call you, nations of the dead — but stand off from the blood!
OD-B11-S01-T02.direction: digs the trench, cuts the victims' throats, bares his sword

OD-B11-S01-T03.line: Then they came — brides and unwed boys, old men worn with toil, girls with grief still fresh, warriors in their bloodied armor — crowding round the trench with a cry that made the cheeks go pale.

OD-B11-S01-T04.line: Back — back, all of you! None drinks before Tiresias of Thebes.
OD-B11-S01-T04.direction: holds the blade over the trench

OD-B11-S02-T01.direction: drifts forward first, unburied, before all the dead

OD-B11-S02-T02.line: No enemy killed him — wine, and the god's own drowsiness. He slept on Circe's roof, forgot the long ladder, fell, and broke his neck; and now he begs for fire and burial on Aeaea.

OD-B11-S02-T03.line: Burn me with all my armor and heap a mound by the grey sea, for an unlucky man that men to come may know of. And plant above it the oar I pulled while I lived among my friends — will you do this for me?

OD-B11-S02-T04.line: All this I will do, poor Elpenor — I will leave nothing undone. When I stand again on Aeaea, fire and mound and oar shall be yours.

OD-B11-S03-T01.line: The blood is dark and sweet. Now I know you, son of Laertes.
OD-B11-S03-T01.direction: stoops, drinks, lifts the golden staff

OD-B11-S03-T02.line: You seek a honey-sweet homecoming, but a god will make it bitter. The Earthshaker holds his grudge — you blinded the son he loved, and he does not forget.

OD-B11-S03-T03.line: Hear me, all of you: when you come to Thrinacia, where the cattle of the Sun graze, keep your hands from those herds. Harm them, and I foretell ruin for ship and crew — and if you yourself escape, you come home late and wretched, on a stranger's ship, with every companion lost.
OD-B11-S03-T03.direction: raises his voice to the whole crew

OD-B11-S03-T04.line: Blood in your own hall, an oar on your shoulder, a long walk inland till the sea itself is forgotten.
OD-B11-S03-T04.direction: foretells return, slaughter of suitors, the inland oar journey

OD-B11-S03-T05.line: And there, far from salt water, he must plant the oar and sacrifice to Poseidon; then death will come to him off the sea, gentle as mist, in a sleek old age with his people blessed around him.

OD-B11-S04-T01.line: Come, mother — drink of the blood and know me. It is I, alive, your son.
OD-B11-S04-T01.direction: lowers the sword from the trench

OD-B11-S04-T02.line: And Penelope — my wife, my son, my old father — tell me everything.
OD-B11-S04-T02.direction: listens hungrily to news of home

OD-B11-S04-T03.line: No sickness took you, then. It was longing — longing for me, for my counsels and my gentleness — that stole the honey of your life. My going killed you, mother.
OD-B11-S04-T03.direction: receives the truth like a wound

OD-B11-S04-T04.line: Mother — stay — let me hold you once!
OD-B11-S04-T04.direction: clutches three times at empty shade

OD-B11-S05-T01.line: One at a time, and each shall drink, and each shall speak her line.
OD-B11-S05-T01.direction: orders the shades at sword point

OD-B11-S05-T02.line: First came Tyro, nobly born, who loved the river Enipeus — and Poseidon took the river's shape, and of that bed came Pelias and Neleus. Speak, Tyro; the blood is yours.
OD-B11-S05-T02.direction: grants the first shade her turn

OD-B11-S05-T03.line: Then came Antiope and Alcmene, Megara and sorrowing Epicaste, Chloris, Leda, Iphimedeia, Phaedra, Ariadne — Maera, Clymene, and hateful Eriphyle, each with her story at her lips.
OD-B11-S05-T03.direction: calls the roll of famous women

OD-B11-S05-T04.line: And the trench became a living book of mothers: desire and birth, crime and death, line after line of the world's begetting.

OD-B11-S06-T01.line: Then the shade of Agamemnon, lord of men, drank and knew him and wept — crying that no sea took him, but Aegisthus and his own accursed wife, who cut him down at his own feast as a man fells an ox at the manger.
OD-B11-S06-T01.direction: gives the king's shade the blood

OD-B11-S06-T02.line: He heard Cassandra's dying cry above him as he lay. And the wife turned away — she would not even draw down his eyelids as he went to the house of Death.

OD-B11-S06-T03.line: So take his warning, Odysseus: put in to your own land secretly, not openly. Show your full mind to no woman, not even a faithful wife — the day of trusting them is done.

OD-B11-S06-T04.line: And one thing the king begged to know: does Orestes live — in Orchomenus, in sandy Pylos, with Menelaus in wide Sparta? But Odysseus could tell him nothing, and there was no comfort in the dark.

OD-B11-S07-T01.line: Then came the shade of Achilles, son of Peleus, and with him Patroclus and brave Antilochus — and Ajax, standing apart.

OD-B11-S07-T02.line: Achilles, no man was ever more blessed, nor will be: alive we honored you like a god, and here you rule with power among the dead. Do not grieve at dying — you of all men.
OD-B11-S07-T02.direction: offers consolation the shade will scorn

OD-B11-S07-T03.line: Would you hear of Peleus, and of your son Neoptolemus? Of your father I know nothing — but of the boy I can speak truly, for I myself brought him from Scyros to the war.

OD-B11-S07-T04.line: In council he spoke first and best; in battle he never lagged in the crowd, but charged far ahead. When we crouched inside the wooden horse the other chiefs wept and trembled — he only gripped his sword-hilt and begged me to let him leap out. And he took his prize and sailed home unwounded.

OD-B11-S07-T05.line: At that the shade of swift-footed Achilles strode away in long steps across the asphodel meadow, rejoicing that his son was great.

OD-B11-S07-T06.line: Only Ajax, son of Telamon, stood apart, angry still over the arms of Achilles that Odysseus won. Soft words were called to him — but the shade answered nothing, and went away in silence among the dead.

OD-B11-S08-T01.line: Minos with the golden scepter, judging the dead — and huge Orion, herding before him the ghosts of the beasts he killed on lonely hills.
OD-B11-S08-T01.direction: stares across the meadow of the dead

OD-B11-S08-T02.line: Tityus stretched under the tearing vultures, Tantalus thirsting with water at his chin, Sisyphus shouldering his pitiless stone.

OD-B11-S08-T03.line: I am only shadow — the man himself feasts among the deathless gods and holds fair-ankled Hebe. But you, poor wretch — do you too haul some such doom as I hauled beneath the sun? Son of Zeus I was, and still I slaved for a lesser man, who sent me down even here to drag away the hound.
OD-B11-S08-T03.direction: looms with bow drawn among shrieking dead

OD-B11-S08-T04.line: But the dead came crowding in their tens of thousands with an unearthly cry, and green fear took him — that dread Persephone might send up the Gorgon's head from Hades.

OD-B11-S08-T05.direction: withdraws into the dark as the living man flees to his ship
